zero: Zero item or byte authority leaves live complete child view, original source pointer and allocations unchanged.
retirement: A caller-authorized whole close or parent-return step revokes the direct complete child-group grant before any source/metadata retirement. Actual source pointer/allocation ownership remains retained until explicit physical disposal or real parent handback.
acceptedPrefix: A producer refusal retains a complete accepted prefix and its current schema/labels for inspection. Returning only already replaced committed schema scaffold preserves that accepted prefix. Neither operation begins whole-child retirement.
allGrantPaths: PagedChildOwner.view and PagedChildGroups::group delegate to the same retirement gate; closing owners cannot begin new metadata or operation production.
wrappers: Registry and publication revocation remain separate original accepted-ledger/publication authority. This owner gate does not grant a new source view after those wrappers revoke it.
remaining: Every actual production caller must adopt the owner and gated borrowed facade coherently; raw test-local field inspection is not production source-grant credit.
